Note 6 (ticket 1):

Requested write exceeds the maximum for a contractor with basic training, so the maximum (read) should be granted. Recommend read.
reason: Maurice Perez (E036) requested write access to Source Code. Five notes (HR/IT/Finance/Compliance/Facilities) report full-time Engineer (which would permit write), but the Security DB reports the employee is a contractor with basic security training. The requested write exceeds that maximum, so the maximum (read) is granted.
